title: FOUNDATIONS OF STATISTICAL INFERENCE
description: An introductory course on statistical inference with an emphasis on business applications. Coverage includes descriptive statistics, random variables, probability distributions, sampling and sampling distributions, statistical inference for means and proportions using one and two samples, and linear regression analysis.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: MTH 111, 111Z, 241, 251Z, 251HZ, 251, 251H or minimum score of 060 in 'Math Placement - ALEKS'.
A minimum grade of C- is required in MTH 111, MTH 111Z, MTH 241, MTH 251Z, MTH 251HZ, MTH 251 and MTH 251H.

Students with a term class standing of Freshman may not enroll.

Enrollment is limited to students with a program in:

  • Business Information Systems (044)
  • Supply Chain & Logistic Manage (045)
  • Supply Chain & Logistics Mgmt (075)
  • Business Administration (181)
  • Finance (182)
  • Business Information Systems (183)
  • Accountancy (641)
  • Marketing (799)
  • Business Analytics (899)
  • Cybersecurity Management (A008)
  • Organizational Leadership (A018)
  • Innovation & Entrepreneurship (A039)
  • Healthcare Administration (A046)
  • Sports Business (A050)
